blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Browser agents do not just need more practice. They need to practice the right things. We introduce MiniWeb, a realistic miniature of the web comprising 65 interconnected websites across 15 domains, where agents navigate, search, and transact as people do. Its 369 human-annotated tasks cover everyday workflows and label 37 reusable interaction primitives grouped into 7 skill families, allowing us to diagnose which skills fail rather than only whether a task succeeds. Benchmarking ten open-weight agents, we find that drag & gesture is consistently the weakest family, with no agent solving more than 24% of its instances. To address this gap, we introduce MiniWebGen, a framework that autonomously generates verified, skill-centric training data from MiniWeb. Fine-tuning Qwen3.5-4B on just 3.1K verified trajectories improves single-primitive success by 24.9pp across 13 unseen websites, with gains across every skill family. However, these trajectories teach short-horizon interactions, which do not directly translate to full-task success. We build on this result with MiniWebAgent, which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes full tasks into the skill-level steps it learned to perform. This approach improves task success by 19.4pp points on unseen MiniWeb sites and transfers to external benchmarks, with gains of 9.3pp on WebArena-Lite, 16.1pp on Online-Mind2Web, and 20.0pp on WebVoyager, without training on their trajectories. We provide a simple recipe for compact browser agents: practice reusable skills directly, then compose them to solve unfamiliar tasks.
blocks.zh: 浏览器代理不只是需要更多的练习 。 他们需要练习正确的东西。 我们推出MiniWeb, 由65个互联网站组成, 它的369个人工附加任务涵盖日常工作流程,并标出37个可重复使用的互动原始数据,分为7个技能家庭,使我们能够判断哪些技能失败,而不仅仅是一项任务是否成功。 以10个开放重量级的代理商为基准,我们发现拖放和手势始终是最弱的家族,没有代理商解决超过24%的个案。 为了弥补这一差距,我们引入了MiniWebGen,这个框架可以自主地从MiniWeb生成经过核实的以技能为中心的培训数据. 精细调整 Quen3.5-4B 仅 3.1K 经核实的轨迹 通过24.9pp 通过13个不见踪影的网站 提高单项成功率 然而,这些轨迹传授了短视的相互作用,并不直接转化为全任务的成功. 我们利用这个结果与MiniWebAgent合作,后者将训练有素的执行者与一个将全部任务分解为它所学会的技能级步骤的规划者配对。 这种方法提高了任务成功率,在不见踪影的MiniWeb网址上达到了19.4pp点,并转至外部基准,在WebArena-Lite上取得了9.3pp分,在Online-Mind2Web上取得了16.1pp分,在WebVoyager上取得了20.0pp分,但没有对其轨迹进行培训。 我们为紧凑浏览器代理提供简单的食谱:直接练习可再用技能,再作曲解决不熟悉的任务.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: What makes humans generalists? We rarely learn a complex behavior from scratch. Before learning to ride a bike, we have already spent years learning to balance, coordinate our limbs, recover from mistakes, and navigate through space. New tasks become easier because they reuse skills we have practiced in many other settings. Generalization comes not only from seeing more tasks, but from building a repertoire of reusable skills and learning how to compose them.
blocks.zh: 人类的通才是什么? 我们很少从零开始学习复杂的行为。 在学会骑自行车之前,我们已经花了数年的时间来学习平衡,协调我们的四肢,从错误中恢复过来,并在太空中航行. 新的任务变得容易一些,因为它们是我们在许多其他场合所练习的再利用技能. 一般化不仅来自看到更多的任务,也来自建立可重复使用技能的汇编和学习如何作曲.

blocks.en:
Web agents should be able to learn in the same way.
Current approaches to training general web agents focus on collecting more task trajectories on diverse websites, difficulty, and solution strategies [ 4 , 5 , 31 , 12 ] . While large models can benefit from this scale, compact open-weight agents have limited capacity and training budgets, making the choice of what to practice especially important [ 3 ] . We therefore ask: should a small web agent spend its training budget on more complete tasks, or on the reusable interaction skills those tasks are built from? We study the latter, training on short-horizon, skill-centric trajectories and composing the learned skills at inference time.
blocks.zh:
网络代理应当能够以同样的方式学习.
目前培训一般网络代理商的方法侧重于收集更多不同网站的任务轨迹、难度和解决方案战略[4、5、31、12]。 虽然大型模型可以从这一规模中受益,但紧凑的开放重量代理商的能力和培训预算有限,使得选择什么做法特别重要[3]。 因此,我们问:一个小型网络代理机构是否应该将其培训预算用于更完整的任务,还是用于这些任务从可重复使用的互动技能? 我们研究后者,进行短视、以技能为中心的轨迹培训,并在推论时间整理学到的技能。

blocks.en: We introduce MiniWeb , a collection of 65 websites (Fig. 2 ) built around 37 reusable interaction primitives. Rather than starting from tasks and labeling their skills afterward, we build the environment from the primitives upward (Fig. 3 ) and compose them into 369 human-authored tasks with skill-level verification. This gives us a controlled place to both measure what agents know and practice what they do not.
blocks.zh: 我们推出MiniWeb, 由65个网站(图2)组成, 我们不是从任务开始并标注他们之后的技能,而是从原始人向上(图3)构建环境,将其编成369项人类授权的任务,并进行技能层面的核查。 这给了我们一个可控的地方,既可以衡量特工们知道什么,也可以实践他们不知道什么。

blocks.en: Across ten open-weight agents, we found that drag & gesture is the weakest family for every model (Fig. 1 ), with only 12.4% average success compared with 38.0% for the next-weakest family. Web- and computer-use-specialized agents perform even worse on dragging than general VLMs despite being stronger on common interactions such as typing. We believe that scaling end-to-end task trajectories can systematically favor frequently encountered interactions while leaving rarer but reusable skills underpracticed.
blocks.zh: 在十个开放重量级的代理商中,我们发现拖动手势是每个型号(图1)最弱的家族,平均成功率只有12.4%,而次弱家族的平均成功率为38.0%。 尽管在打字等常见相互作用上表现得更强,但网络和计算机专用制剂在拖曳方面的表现比一般的VLM更差。 我们认为,缩小端到端任务轨迹可有系统地支持经常遇到的相互作用,同时保留较少但可重复使用的技能。

blocks.en: To test whether skill-specific practice closes these gaps, we introduce MiniWebGen , a multi-agent pipeline that generates verified trajectories for skills in MiniWeb . Training Qwen3.5-4B on 3.1K generated trajectories improves success on held-out single-primitive tasks by 24.9 points, with gains across all skill families. These gains do not automatically transfer to full tasks, so we introduce MiniWebAgent , which pairs the trained executor with a planner that decomposes tasks into practiced interactions. This approach improves success on held-out MiniWeb sites by 19.4 points and transfers to three external benchmarks without target-benchmark training: +9.3 points on WebArena-Lite, +20.0 on WebVoyager, and +16.1 on Online-Mind2Web. Overall, we contribute the following:

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Web benchmarks aim for realism, reproducibility, or coverage. MiniWoB and MiniWoB++ [ 25 , 17 ] pioneered synthetic environments for low-level web interaction, with small self-contained pages that exercise individual widgets such as sliders and drag targets. Self-hosted environments such as WebShop [ 35 ] , WebArena [ 39 ] , WorkArena [ 7 ] , and MyPCBench [ 15 ] provide realistic locally hosted websites, but are limited in term of coverage, while Mind2Web [ 6 ] and live-web benchmarks [ 13 , 34 , 16 , 9 ] broaden coverage at the cost of task stability and reproducibility. Environment-generation pipelines address this by compiling real-site interaction structures into finite-state machines [ 31 ] , generating environments with verifiable tasks [ 38 , 5 ] , or synthesizing versions of webpages [ 14 ] . Most of these benchmarks score whole tasks: step-level metrics [ 6 ] , progress rates [ 18 ] , and key-node evaluation [ 22 ] . They measure how far an agent gets but do not attribute a failure to a specific skill. Concurrent with our work, ComponentBench [ 11 ] evaluates agents on 97 canonical UI components, including sliders and date pickers, using programmatically verified tasks across three React component libraries. MiniWeb shares this focus on interaction skills but embeds them in full multi-page websites with persistent backend interactions. It also composes primitives into multi-step, cross-site tasks and provides skill-segmented demonstrations with per-primitive verdicts.
blocks.zh: 网络基准旨在现实主义、可复制性或覆盖性。 MiniWoB和MiniWoB++[25,17]开创了低级网络交互的合成环境,有小型自成一体的页面,可以操作滑动器和拖动目标等单个部件. 诸如WebShop[35],WebArena[39],WorkArena[7],和MyPC Bench[15]等自办环境提供现实的本地主机网站,但覆盖范围有限,而Mind2Web[6]和现场网络基准[13,34,16,9]则以任务稳定性和可复制性为代价扩大覆盖范围. 环境生成管道通过将真实的现场相互作用结构汇编成有限状态机器[31],产生具有可核查任务的环境[38,5],或合成网页版本[14]来解决这个问题。 大多数这些基准都得分整个任务:阶梯级度量衡[6],进度率[18],以及关键点评价[22]. 它们衡量代理人获得多大程度,但不将失败归因于特定技能。 配合我们的工作,Ministry Bench [11] 利用三个React 组件库中经过程序验证的任务,对97个cononical UI组件(包括滑轮和采枣机)的代理进行评估。 MiniWeb分享了这种对交互技能的关注,但将其嵌入有持久后端互动的完整多页网站. 它还将原始人编成多步,跨地点的任务,并提供技能分门别类的演示,并附有每一级判决.

blocks.en: Web agents are traditionally trained on end-to-end task trajectories [ 13 , 24 , 12 , 32 , 28 ] . Recent work has scaled these training corpora by converting tutorials into demonstrations [ 21 , 33 ] , relabeling or reverse-synthesizing tasks from exploration [ 19 , 26 ] , or collecting trajectories on the live web [ 27 ] . These pipelines inherit the coverage of their sources, whereas MiniWebGen uses privileged knowledge of each site to direct generation at predefined primitives, including interactions that end-to-end data rarely contains (dragging, searching, …). While other work reuses skills at inference time as induced workflows [ 30 ] or distilled APIs [ 37 ] , we instead train skills into an executor’s weights through practice. To compose them, MiniWebAgent adopts the established separation of planning from execution found in planner–grounder designs [ 36 , 10 ] , manager–worker frameworks [ 1 , 2 ] , and plan-and-act agents [ 8 , 23 ] . Our contribution is not this architecture but the experience used to train the executor: we examine whether targeted practice improves individual interactions on unseen websites, and whether a planner can compose those improvements into more successful multi-step task execution.
blocks.zh: 网络代理传统上接受端到端任务轨迹[13,24,12,32,28]的培训. 近期的工作通过将教程转换为演示[21,33],从探索[19,26]中重新标注或反向合成任务,或在直播网上收集轨迹[27],扩大了这些培训公司的规模. 这些管道继承了源头的覆盖,而MiniWebGen则利用每个站点的特权知识在预先定义的原始物上直接生成,包括端到端数据很少包含的相互作用(拖曳,搜索,. 虽然其他工作在推论时重新利用技能作为诱导的工作流程[30]或提炼API[37],但我们却通过实践将技能训练成执行者的权重. 为了作曲,MiniWebAgent采用了既定的规划与规划者-地层设计[36,10],管理者-工人框架[1,2],以及计划与行动代理人[8,23]中的执行分离。 我们的贡献不是这个架构,而是用来培训执行者的经验:我们审查有针对性的做法是否改善了在看不见网站上的个人互动,以及规划者是否能够将这些改进转化为更成功的多步骤任务执行。

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We want to study the primitive skills, or macros, of current web agents. Given a task that requires a specific set of skills, can an agent reliably perform each one? When the task fails, can we identify which skill it struggled with? To answer these questions, we need tasks whose component skills are explicit and can be evaluated separately, which current web-agent benchmarks do not provide [ 39 , 6 , 13 , 35 , 15 , 14 , 9 ] (Tab. 1 ).
blocks.zh: 我们希望研究当前网络代理商的原始技能或宏观技术。 鉴于一项任务需要一套具体的技能,一个特工能否可靠地完成每一项任务? 当任务失败时,我们能够确定它所挣扎的技巧吗? 为了回答这些问题,我们需要任务,其组成部分技能是明确的,可以单独评价,而目前的网络代理基准没有提供[39、6、13、35、15、14、9](第1段)。

blocks.en: 3.1 MiniWeb
blocks.zh: 3.1 小型网络

blocks.en: We introduce MiniWeb , a collection of 65 synthetic websites built around 37 interaction primitives. We build it from the bottom up (Fig. 3 ): First the primitives, then supporting websites, and finally tasks that chain them together.
blocks.zh: 我们介绍MiniWeb, 收集65个合成网站, 我们从下而上地建造它(图3): 先是原始人,然后是支持网站,最后是把网站连在一起的任务。

blocks.en: The set of primitives a web agent needs is hard to enumerate from first principles, so we start from existing data. With Claude Opus 4.8, we label 15.7K tasks from WebArena [ 39 ] , WebShop [ 35 ] , WebVoyager [ 13 ] , and Mind2Web [ 6 ] with the recurring interaction patterns that each requires, reusing an existing label whenever one fits. This first pass yields 139 candidate macros, which are dominated by searching, filtering, and extracting information, and only 0.3% of their 52K labels involve dragging and none drawing, uploading a file, or editing a spreadsheet cell. In group brainstorming sessions, we merge near-duplicate and site-specific candidates, add the interactions the source benchmarks miss, and separate reasoning from the physical interaction. The result is an initial set of 46 primitives , which we refine after annotation. Each is a site-agnostic interaction with a single purpose that may take several browser actions, such as filtering items with a slider or editing a spreadsheet cell. We group them into 7 skill families (Fig. 3 ). blocks.en: We select 65 websites across 15 representative domains to cover a broad range of interaction primitives and cross-site workflows. Half of these domains are absent from WebArena [ 39 ] , Mind2Web [ 6 ] , WebVoyager [ 13 ] , and WebShop [ 35 ] . We then have annotators specify each site’s supported primitives, features, and connections to other sites. These links form an information flow graph, which allow for realistic cross-site features such as payment confirmations or cross-site sharing. For realistic content, 21 sites are seeded from public datasets 1 1 1 We note the license of each data source we used in Tab. 8 . , which we join through a synthetic layer of users and accounts. The remaining 44 sites use deterministic synthetic data, for about 4M records in total. More details can be seen in Fig. 2 . A coding agent 2 2 2 We used Claude Code with Opus 4.8. implements each site’s frontend and backend from its specification, and all the authors and annotators review every site and fix it until it supports its primitives. The entire process took roughly a month with 6 annotators working 8 hours a week. The backends log every request in a session and write all changes to a per-session overlay, so verifiers can inspect what an agent did, and many agents can run in parallel from the same initial state.

blocks.en: 4 Experiments and Analyses
blocks.zh: 4 实验和分析

blocks.en: We use MiniWeb to ask four questions. Which skills do current web agents lack (Sec. 4.1 )? Does practicing skills in isolation improve them, and the tasks that chain them (Sec. 4.2 )? Does an agent that composes trained skills transfer to websites and benchmarks it never saw (Sec. 4.3 )? And does our skill-centric data transfer better than a task-centric corpus of the same size (Sec. 4.4 )?
blocks.zh: 我们用MiniWeb来问四个问题. 目前网络代理缺乏哪些技能(第4.1条)? 孤立地练习技能是否改善这些技能,以及将其连锁起来的任务(第4.2条)? 是否有一个代理人负责将训练有素的技能转移到其从未见过的网站和基准(第4.3节)? 我们以技能为中心的数据传输是否优于同样大小的任务中心数据(第4.4节)?

blocks.en: We profile ten open-weight agents (Tab. 2 ): four general models in the browser-use harness [ 20 ] and six web or computer-use agents in their native agent loops [ 4 , 5 , 12 , 24 , 29 ] . For training experiments, we use Qwen3.5-4B and compare an untrained single agent, a single agent trained on all MiniWebGen trajectories, an untrained planner-executor, and MiniWebAgent , which pairs the planner with the trained executor (Tab. 3 ). To isolate the effect of training data, we also train the same executor on a size-matched set of task-centric trajectories collected on our training sites with InSTA’s pipeline [ 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们剖析了十个开放量级代理(Tab. 2):浏览器-使用带中的四个通用型号[20],以及六个网络或计算机使用代理在其本土代理环 [4,5,12,24,29]. 在训练实验中,我们使用Quen3.5-4B,并比较一个未经训练的单一剂,一个受过所有MiniWebGen轨迹训练的单一剂,一个未经训练的规划器-执行器,以及MiniWebAgent,它将计划器与经过训练的执行器(Tab. 3)配对. 为了隔离培训数据的影响,我们还培训了同一个执行者,使其掌握一套以任务为中心、规模相称的轨迹。

blocks.en: Training uses only the 52 MiniWeb training sites. We evaluate on 62 human-authored tasks and 103 generated single-primitive tasks from 13 held-out sites, as well as WebArena-Lite, WebVoyager, and Online-Mind2Web. For the live benchmarks, we exclude tasks that are impossible or blocked by our network; full evaluation details, action budgets, repeated-run protocol, and statistical tests appear in Supp. J and Supp. H . We report our key findings below:
blocks.zh: 培训只使用52个MiniWeb培训站点. 我们评价了62项人类授权的任务,103项从13个被搁置的网站以及WebArena-Lite、WebVoyager和Online-Mind2Web生成的单一原始任务。 对于现场基准,我们排除了我们网络无法完成或无法完成的任务;全面的评估细节、行动预算、重复运行的协议和统计测试都出现在Supp中。 J和Supp. (中文(简体) ). 我们报告我们的主要调查结果如下:

blocks.en: 4.1 Drag & gesture Ag is the weakest family in all web agent models.
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 拖动手势( P) Ag是所有网络代理模式中最弱的家族.

blocks.en: As shown in Tab. 2 , drag & gesture Ag is the weakest skill family for every untrained agent. Web and computer-use agents perform worse on drag than general models (9.0% vs. 18.0% on average), despite performing better on typing, suggesting that end-to-end web training underrepresents rarer interactions such as dragging. Although drag is our smallest family, the gap is large: pooled across agents, drag reaches only 12.4% success, compared with 38.0% for the next-weakest family, out-of-page I/O Ag .
blocks.zh: 如塔布所示. 2, 拖动手势( P) Ag是每个未受过训练的特工中最弱的技能家庭. 尽管在打字方面表现较好,但网络和计算机使用代理人的拖动性能比一般模型(平均为9.0%对18.0%)要差,这表明端到端的网络培训不代表拖动等罕见的互动。 尽管拖拽是我们最小的家族, 差距很大: 跨代理,拖拽只达到12.4%的成功率,

blocks.en: The failures are also highly localized. In 72% of failed drag instances, the agent reaches the correct slider or canvas but fails during the gesture or immediately afterward (Fig. 5 ). Dragging is typically planned open-loop from a single screenshot, while the resulting value only becomes visible after release, so small spatial errors can directly produce an incorrect result. When agents do set sliders exactly, they often avoid dragging altogether by using arrow keys or directly entering the value. This suggests that the bottleneck is not reaching the right interface element, but executing and verifying the gesture itself.
blocks.zh: 这些失败也是高度本地化的。 在72%的拖曳失败中,代理到达正确的滑动器或帆布,但在手势中或紧接着失败(图5). 拖曳一般是从单个截图中规划的开放-loop,而产生的值只有在发布后才能显现出来,因此小的空间误差可以直接产生不正确的结果. 当代理商确实精确设置了滑动器时,它们往往避免通过使用箭头键或直接输入值来完全拖动. 这表明瓶颈没有达到正确的界面元素,而是执行和验证手势本身.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Most drag failures happen at the gesture itself. Outcomes of the ten untrained agents on every drag & gesture Ag instance (11 slider and 6 signature tasks), from the VLM judge’s explanations; bypassed means, e.g . , typing a name instead of drawing it.
blocks.zh: 图5:大多数拖曳失败发生在手势本身. 每个拖动手势上的十个未经训练的特工的结果 从VLM法官的解释来看,Ag example(11个滑轮和6个签名任务);被绕过,例如输入一个名字而不是绘制它。

blocks.en: More broadly, the ten agents exhibit distinct skill profiles even when their overall task success is similar. Task success correlates strongly with discrete selection Ag , form transactions Ag , and reasoning Ag (Spearman ρ \rho of 0.96, 0.83, and 0.95), but only weakly with text entry Ag ( ρ = 0.21 \rho=0.21 ). For example, Qwen3.5-9B and Fara1.5-4B differ by only 1.6 points in task success, yet Fara1.5-4B is 8 points better at navigation Ag and 6 points worse at discrete selection Ag . Reasoning Ag skills show similar variation: aggregation is consistently difficult, with counting harder than reading a value for every agent and finding an extremum harder for eight of ten, likely because both require maintaining state across scrolls or pages.
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,这10名代理人表现出独特的技能特征,即使他们的总体任务成功程度类似。 任务成功与离散选择 Ag, 形式交易 Ag, 和推理 Ag (Spearman $\rho $0.96, 0.83, 和 0.95) 密切相关,但与文本条目 Ag( ^ = 0.21\rho = 0.21) 关系不大。 例如,Qwen3.5-9B和Fara1.5-4B在任务成功中只差1.6分,而Fara1.5-4B在导航Ag上则好8分,在离散选择Ag上则差6分. 理由说明 Ag 技能显示类似差异: 汇总一直很困难, 计数比读取每个代理的值更困难, 在十项中的八项更难找到极限值, 可能是因为两者都要求保持整个卷轴或页面的状态。

blocks.en: These primitive-level weaknesses matter because they compound over longer tasks. As task length increases, success falls steeply (Fig. 6 , left): averaged across the ten agents, an n n -primitive task succeeds at roughly p n p^{n} , within 3.8 points at every length, where p = 62 % p=62\% is mean success on one-primitive tasks. Since every primitive in a chain must succeed, even modest gains at the primitive level compound across the task. This is precisely what skill-specific practice targets.

blocks.en: 4.2 MiniWeb practice improves single-primitive task generation, but not task success.
blocks.zh: 4.2 MiniWeb的实践改进了单主任务生成,但任务成功与否.

blocks.en: Since task success compounds over a task’s primitives, MiniWebGen trains the agent directly on those primitives. This works at the skill level: on 103 generated single-primitive tasks from held-out sites, Qwen3.5-4B improves from 55.3% to 80.3% success, with gains across every skill family (Fig. 7 ). But these gains do not transfer to full tasks. On 62 human-authored held-out tasks, primitive success remains essentially unchanged (44.1% to 45.1%), and so does task success (38.7% to 39.2%); performance also drops on all three external benchmarks (Tab. 3 ).
blocks.zh: MiniWebGen直接在原始人身上训练毒剂。 这在技能层面起作用:在103个从被搁置地点产生的单项原始任务中,Quen3.5-4B成功率从55.3%提高到80.3%,每个技能家庭都有收获(图7)。 但是,这些成果并没有完全转移到任务上。 在62项人类授权的搁置任务中,原始成功基本上保持不变(44.1%至45.1%),任务成功率也一样(38.7%至39.2%);所有三项外部基准的绩效也都有所下降(第3段)。

blocks.en: The problem is composition. MiniWebGen trains mostly on one-primitive episodes with instructions that explicitly name the skill, while real tasks chain several primitives under a single high-level request. The trained single agent therefore often stops before reaching the skills it learned. Supp. J analyzes this further. MiniWebAgent addresses both mismatches with a planner: an untrained planner decomposes the task into primitive-level instructions, and the trained executor carries out each one in the setting it practiced.
blocks.zh: 问题是组成问题。 小型网络 Gen列车大多在一款原创节目中进行,并附有明确命名技能的指令,而现实任务则将几个原始人连锁在一个单高等级的请求下. 因此,训练有素的单一代理人往往在达到所学技能之前就停止工作。 苏普。 J进一步分析了这一点. MiniWebAgent处理两个与计划员的不匹配:一个未经训练的规划员将任务分解成原始级别的指令,经过训练的执行员在它练习的设定中执行每个任务.

blocks.en: 4.3 Composing trained skills raises task success on unseen websites and benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 培养训练有素的技能有助于在看不见的网站和基准上成功完成任务。

blocks.en: With a planner, the practiced primitives translate into end-to-end task success (Tab. 3 ). Relative to the untrained single agent, MiniWebAgent gains 19.4 points on held-out MiniWeb sites and improves by 9.3, 20.0, and 16.1 points on WebArena-Lite, WebVoyager, and Online-Mind2Web, respectively, without training on target-benchmark trajectories.
blocks.zh: 有了计划员,实践的原始人就转化为端到端任务的成功(Tab. 3). 相对于未经过训练的单一代理,MiniWebAgent在被搁置的MiniWeb网站获得19.4分,并在WebArena-Lite,WebVoyager和Online-Mind2Web上分别提高9.3分,20.0分和16.1分,但没有接受目标基准轨迹培训.

blocks.en: The planner and trained executor contribute differently. Planning alone gives its largest gain on WebVoyager, where long information-seeking tasks benefit from decomposition, but helps little elsewhere. Adding the trained executor consistently improves over the untrained planner across all four evaluations. On held-out MiniWeb tasks, MiniWebAgent also raises primitive success from 49.8% to 63.7%, with gains across every skill family. As expected from compounding primitive failures, the advantage grows on longer tasks: for tasks with three or more primitives, MiniWebAgent more than doubles the success of the untrained single agent (33.3% vs. 14.5%) (Fig. 6 , right).
blocks.zh: 策划者和训练有素的执行者的贡献不同. 规划本身在WebVoyager上获得了最大的收益,在那里,长期的信息搜索任务从分解中受益,但在别处却没有什么帮助. 在所有四项评价中,增加训练有素的执行人员比未训练有素的规划人员不断改进。 在被搁置的MiniWeb任务上,MiniWebAgent还将原始的成功率从49.8%提高到63.7%,每个技能家庭都有收获. 根据复合原始失败的预期,优势在更长的任务上增长:对于三个或三个以上原始的任务,MiniWebAgent比未经过训练的单一代理成功率(33.3%对14.5%)增加一倍以上(图6,右).

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Practice lifts every skill family. Success per skill family on the 103 generated single-primitive tasks of the held-out sites, for a single Qwen3.5-4B agent untrained (grey) and trained on our data (blue), with the gain at the right; reasoning Ag , which is not trained, is left out.
blocks.zh: 图7:实践提升了每个技能家庭。 每个技能家庭在103个被搁置地点产生的单项原始任务上的成功,对于一个没有受过训练的Quen3.5-4B代理(灰色)和我们的数据培训(蓝色)来说是成功的,其收益在右边;没有经过训练的推理Ag被忽略了。

blocks.en: 4.4 At matched size, our skill data matches or beats task-centric data.
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 在匹配的大小,我们的技能数据匹配或比对以任务为中心的数据。

blocks.en: Does the gain come from skill-specific practice, or simply from training on more web trajectories? To test this, we reimplemented InSTA’s trajectory collection pipeline on MiniWeb [ 27 ] to collect a size-matched corpus of task-centric trajectories of MiniWeb , which, like our skill data, Qwen3.5-4B writes. We then train the same executor on such corpus. The task-centric executor does not significantly improve over the untrained planner on any of the four benchmarks, while our skill-trained executor does on all four (Tab. 3 ). Head to head, our executor is ahead everywhere, and the gap is significant on Online-Mind2Web (+10.7 points, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ) and held-out MiniWeb (+10.2, p = 0.027 p=0.027 ; Holm p = 0.081 p=0.081 ). At this size, skill-centric data is at least as useful as task-centric data, and it is the one that reliably adds to planning.
blocks.zh: 收益是来自特定技能实践,还是仅仅来自更多网络轨迹的培训? 为了测试这一点,我们重新在MiniWeb[27]上执行InSTA的轨迹收集管道,以收集一个大小匹配的MiniWeb以任务为中心的轨迹,这与我们的技能数据一样,Quen3.5-4B写道. 然后,我们培训同样的执行人 关于这种程序。 以任务为中心的执行者没有比四个基准中任何一个没有经过训练的规划者大有改进,而我们经过技术训练的执行者则在所有四个基准上都有改进(第3段)。 从头到头,我们的执行者在任何地方都领先,在Online-Mind2Web(+10.7 点,p < 0.001 p < 0.001)和挂起的MiniWeb(+10.2,p=0.027 p=0.027;Holm p=0.081 p=0.081)上差距很大。 在这种规模下,以技能为中心的数据至少与以任务为中心的数据一样有用,它是可靠地增加规划内容的。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we introduce MiniWeb , a synthetic benchmark centered on 37 interaction primitives across 65 locally hosted websites, providing per-primitive evaluation and skill-segmented data generation for web agents. Its skill profiles show that drag & gesture Ag is the weakest skill family of every agent we tested. Using this infrastructure, MiniWebGen expands limited seed demonstrations into 3.1K verified trajectories for targeted skill practice. Fine-tuning a compact base model on them improves the execution of single primitives, but on its own it does not raise success on multi-step tasks and lowers it on external benchmarks, because the model learns single primitives from single-primitive episodes, not how to chain them: it stops after one primitive, and removing that stop alone does not help. MiniWebAgent separates task planning from practiced skill execution; without training on any target-benchmark trajectories, it improves over the base model on the held-out sites, WebArena-Lite, WebVoyager, and Online-Mind2Web, and its trained executor adds to what planning alone achieves, most on the held-out sites and Online-Mind2Web. Our findings suggest that targeted skill practice on synthetic websites, combined with an explicit separation of planning and execution, helps compact open-weight agents on websites they were not trained on.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们引入了MiniWeb,这是一个以遍及65个本地主机网站的37个互动原始为核心的合成基准,为网络代理商提供每个原始的评价和按技能分类的数据生成. 其技能配置显示拖动手势( P) Ag是我们测试过的每个特工中最薄弱的 利用这一基础设施,MiniWebGen将有限的种子演示扩展为3.1K经核实的轨迹,用于定向技能练习. 在它们身上精细调整一个紧凑的基模型可以改善单原始物的执行,但单靠它本身并不能提高多步任务的成功率,更能降低外部基准,因为模型从单原始物中学习到单原始物,而不是如何连锁:它在一个原始物之后停止,而单独去除这种停止也无济于事. MiniWebAgent将任务规划与实践技能执行区分开来;没有对任何目标基准轨迹的培训,它比被搁置网站,WebArena-Lite,WebVoyager,和Online-Mind2Web的基础模型有所改进,其训练有素的执行者补充了仅是被搁置网站和Online-Mind2Web的规划成就. 我们的调查结果表明,在合成网站上有针对性地开展技能实践,同时明确区分规划和执行,有助于在未接受过培训的网站上建立紧凑的开放式代理商。

blocks.en: 6 Limitations & Future Works
blocks.zh: 6 限制和未来工程

blocks.en: We acknowledge several limitations in our study. First, MiniWeb contains fewer human-authored tasks than Mind2Web [ 6 ] and WebArena [ 39 ] . Although our annotation interface (Supp. D ) streamlines task creation and trajectory recording, devising diverse tasks still requires substantial effort and creativity. MiniWebGen alleviates training-data scarcity but does not replace broader human-authored evaluation. Second, although parameterized verifiers reduce grading costs, running closed-source frontier agents remains expensive. We therefore leave these agents unevaluated, reflecting both resource constraints and our focus on small open-weight models. Third, we do not fully resolve the drag & gesture Ag deficiencies identified by our benchmark. Our focus is on showing that improvements across skill families, when composed, can improve task performance on unseen websites, rather than achieving mastery of any individual skill. We leave specialized methods for mastering drag & gesture Ag interactions to future work. Finally, this study does not include scaling experiments due to compute and evaluation costs. Future work should investigate how skill-centric training performs with larger datasets, greater website diversity, and larger models.
blocks.zh: 我们承认我们的研究有一些局限性。 首先,MiniWeb包含的人类授权任务比Mind2Web[6]和WebArena[39]更少. 虽然我们的注释界面(Supp.D)精简了任务的创造和轨迹记录,但设计各种任务仍然需要大量的努力和创造性。 小型网络 Gen缓解了培训-数据稀缺,但并不能取代更广泛的由人类授权的评价。 第二,尽管参数化核查器降低了分级成本,但运行的封闭源代码边境代理仍然昂贵。 因此,我们没有对这些代理人进行评价,这既反映了资源限制,也反映了我们对小型开放量模型的重视。 第三,我们没有完全解决拖动手势( S) 根据我们的基准查明的缺陷。 我们的重点是表明,技能家庭的改进,一旦组成,可以改善在隐形网站上的任务业绩,而不是掌握任何个人技能。 我们把掌握拖动和手势Ag互动的专门方法留给今后的工作。 最后,本研究不包括因计算和评价成本造成的缩放实验. 今后的工作应调查以技能为中心的培训如何以更大的数据集、更大的网站多样性和更大的模型进行。

blocks.en: A.1 What is a macro?
blocks.zh: A.1 联合国 什么是宏观?

blocks.en:
We define a macro as the smallest unit of web interaction that carries a
distinct, recurring intent . A macro occupies an intermediate level of
granularity between an atomic action ( click , keystroke , or scroll ) and
a task , a high-level natural-language goal that may require extended
planning to fulfil. A macro is short-horizon : it realizes a single coherent
intent through a short, contiguous chain of atomic actions and requires no further
decomposition into sub-goals. Crucially, macros are written site-agnostically .

blocks.en: A.2 Macro bank creation
blocks.zh: A.2 大型银行的创建

blocks.en:
We construct the macro bank through a combination of LLM-driven induction and
human supervision. The procedure first elicits a prior over the macro space by
mining the tasks of four existing web-agent benchmarks (WebArena, WebVoyager,
Mind2Web, and WebShop), and then extends this seed bank to the domains of MiniWeb .
The induction is orchestrated by prompting Claude Opus 4.8 to operate over a
relational store with four tables: a verb bank 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , a modifier
bank ℳ \mathcal{M} , a macro bank, and the pooled task set. The process proceeds in
three stages.

三个阶段。

blocks.en:
We pool the tasks from all four datasets into a single corpus and process them
iteratively. For each task, the agent reasons about the sub-goals required to
accomplish it and proposes the macros, and where necessary the constituent verbs
and modifiers, needed to express those sub-goals. When an existing entry in 𝒱 \mathcal{V} or ℳ \mathcal{M} suffices, the agent reuses it; otherwise it proposes
a new verb or modifier and marks it as proposed. Throughout, the agent consults the
current state of the bank before each addition to avoid introducing redundant
entries.

vocabularies contain near-duplicates. The agent therefore reviews 𝒱 \mathcal{V} and ℳ \mathcal{M} and flags candidate duplications, which are then adjudicated by a
human annotator who either merges each entry into an existing verb or modifier or
keeps it as distinct. This step yields the curated vocabularies that fix the macro
bank.

The macro assignments produced during the first pass are confounded by the order in
which tasks were processed, since the bank was still growing as tasks were seen. To
remove this dependence, we discard the first-pass assignments, fix the curated bank
from the deduplication step, and prompt the agent to reassign macros to every task
from scratch, disregarding the prior assignments. Fixing the reference bank ensures
that each task is labeled against the same macro vocabulary, independent of its
position in the corpus.

blocks.en: A.4 From candidates to primitives
blocks.zh: A.4 从候选人到原始人

blocks.en: The candidates describe what existing tasks ask for at the granularity of their instructions, so many differ only in the value they target. In group brainstorming sessions we merged candidates that perform the same interaction on different values ( e.g . , the 27 select candidates, such as select_by_color and select_by_size , are choices from a set of options), removed site-specific ones, and separated reasoning from the physical interaction: the extract , compute , compare , and verify candidates correspond to the reasoning operations of Supp. B , which are attached to the interaction they follow. We then added interactions the benchmarks rarely or never exercise, such as dragging a slider, drawing a signature, uploading a file, and editing a spreadsheet cell. This gave the initial set of 46 primitives in 7 skill families (Sec. 3.1 ). After annotation, we kept the 37 primitives that annotators used at least 3 times (Supp. B ).

blocks.en: Every primitive instance in a MiniWeb task carries two tags: a base primitive , the physical interaction ( e.g . , filter_by_slider ), and an optional reasoning operation the agent applies to what it sees ( e.g . , extremum ). An answer the agent must return to the user is tagged with the operation-only primitive report_information ; reasoning that only serves a later step is attached to the primitive it belongs to rather than tagged on its own. Primitives are called macros in our code and in the induction pipeline of Supp. A .

blocks.en: MiniWeb has 65 websites in 15 domains, served offline by one local server. They share one fictional world (a city, Lakeport, WA, and a company, Meridian Systems, recur across sites), so one task can move between sites. Six hubs carry the effects of actions across sites: WebMail receives receipts, notifications and two-factor codes, SecureBank records payments and trades, CalendarTodo receives bookings, MeridianCloud stores created files, QuickChat receives messages, and VaultGuard stores passwords. Twenty-one sites are seeded from public datasets; the other 44 hold synthetic data generated with fixed seeds. Thirteen sites are held out: no training data comes from them, and they are used only for evaluation (Sec. 4 ).
blocks.zh: MiniWeb拥有15个域的65个网站,由一个本地服务器提供离线服务. 他们共享一个虚构的世界(一个城市,湖港,WA,和一家公司,Meridian Systems,跨站点重复),因此一项任务可以在站点之间移动. 6个中心站点传递行动的效果: WebMail接收到收据,通知和两要素代码,SecureBank记录支付和交易,CaxTodo接收预订,MeridianCloud商店创建文件,QuickChat接收消息,VaultGuard存储密码. 21个站点来自公共数据集的种子;其他44个站点持有用固定种子生成的合成数据. 保留了13个网站:没有培训数据来自这些网站,它们只用于评价(第4节)。

blocks.en: Appendix D Annotation interface
blocks.zh: 附录D 注释接口

blocks.en: Six annotators wrote and recorded the 369 tasks in a web tool served next to the sites (Fig. 8 ). Its dashboard orders the work in three steps: review each site and report bugs, annotate tasks, and build their verifiers. It also shows the current coverage of every primitive, least covered first.
blocks.zh: 6名注释员将369项任务写成并记录在网站旁边的一个网络工具中(图8)。 它的仪表板分三步命令工作:审查每个站点并报告错误,注释任务,以及建立其验证器. 也显示了目前每个原始的,最少的覆盖.

blocks.en: The tool samples one to three sites and a set of primitives to cover, weighted toward primitives with few tasks. The annotator first explores the sites freely, then designs the task as a graph in the editor below the browser: one node per primitive instance with its subtask and reasoning operation, and edges for the order and data flow between instances. Every primitive of a multi-primitive task must be connected. The annotator then writes the instruction in their own words, sets the starting login and two-factor state, and records the task in the embedded browser. After recording, they mark each instance’s span on the action timeline and enter the expected answer. Optional LLM helpers draft a task, rephrase an instruction, or infer a primitive chain from it; their output is only a suggestion. Annotators can also propose a new primitive, which is added to the registry for later review.
blocks.zh: 工具样本1到3个地点 和一组原始人来覆盖, 向原始人倾斜 几乎没有任务。 注释者首先对网站进行自由探索,然后在浏览器下面的编辑器中将任务设计为图表:每个原始实例有一个带有子任务和推理操作的节点,以及实例之间的顺序和数据流的边缘. 每一个原始的多原始任务都必须互相连接. 注释者然后用自己的单词写出指令,设定起始登录状态和两个要素状态,并在嵌入式浏览器中记录任务. 在录制后,它们会在行动时间表上标注每个实例的跨度,并输入预期的答案。 可选 LLM 帮助者起草任务,重写指令,或从中推断出一个原始的链条;他们的输出只是建议. 注释者也可以提出一个新的原始的,添加到登记册中以供以后审查.

blocks.en: For each primitive instance the verifier builder shows the gold HTTP requests from the recording and a check scaffold: request gates, actions, visited pages, and an answer matcher. The annotator pins the values the instruction dictates, marks the remaining checks as advisory, and tests the verifier in a sandbox: it must pass the gold recording and should reject two negative controls, an empty trajectory and an answer given without any action.
blocks.zh: 对于每个原始实例, 验证器构建器会显示来自录音的黄金 HTTP 请求和一个检查脚手架: 请求门, 动作, 访问页, 以及一个答案匹配器 。 注释者将指示所标注的值标定,将其余的检查标记为咨询,并在沙盒中测试核查者:它必须通过黄金记录,并应拒绝两个负控,一个是空轨迹,一个是回答,没有做任何动作.

blocks.en: The macro browser (Fig. 8 b) steps through every recorded span of one primitive across all tasks. Reviewers used it to make tags consistent across annotators. A task review page compares each task with its state before correction; a reviewer marks it verified or stale, asks for a re-recording, or deletes it.
blocks.zh: 宏浏览器(图8b)跨越所有任务的每一个记录的原始跨度。 评论员们用它来制作横跨注释者的标签一致. 任务审查页面在更正前将每项任务与其状态进行比较;审查者对其进行校验或暂停、要求重新记录或删除。

blocks.en: Appendix E Grader validation
blocks.zh: 附录E 年级验证

blocks.en: Every task is graded twice: by its parameterized verifiers, which check the backend request log, and by the VLM judge (Gemini 3.5 Flash), which reads each primitive’s rubric, the request log, and the screenshots (Sec. 3.1 ; the judge’s prompt is in Supp. K ). We check both against human demonstrations and measure how often they agree on agent episodes.
blocks.zh: 每个任务分级为两次:通过参数化的核查员检查后端请求日志,以及读取每个原始的面额、请求日志和截图的VLM裁判员(Gemini 3.5 Flash)(Sec 3.1;法官的提示为Supp. K)。 我们既检查人类的示威游行,又衡量他们在多大程度上同意代理人事件。

blocks.en: A human recording can stand in for a correct episode only if it is current and complete. Of the 369 recordings, we leave out the 67 tagged as stale, which predate a change to their site, data, or task, and the 119 that the task’s current verifier rejects, such as early recordings whose recorder missed the graded form submission or recordings made before the task was edited. The remaining 183 recordings pass the verifier by construction.
blocks.zh: 人类的录音只有在时速和完整的情况下才能为正确的剧集站出来. 在369张录音中,我们省略了67张被标记为呆板的录音,这些录音在更改其网站、数据或任务之前就已存在,以及任务当前核查者拒绝的119张录音,例如早期录音,其记录员错过了分级表格的提交或任务编辑前的录音。 其余183张录音通过构件通过验证.

blocks.en: From each valid recording we build three cases: the recording with the annotator’s answer (should pass); a near miss , the same recording cut just before its last required primitive instance and without an answer (should fail); and an empty episode with no actions and no answer (should fail). Over these 549 cases, the verifiers are 98.9% accurate and the judge 98.2%. The verifiers pass every positive and the judge 97.8% of them; both reject every empty episode, and each accepts 6 of the 182 near misses. The judge’s reference answer comes from the same recording, so the positives are an easy case for it; the near misses are the informative part.
blocks.zh: 从每一个有效的记录中,我们构建了三个案例:用注释员的回答录制(应该通过),一个几乎失手的,同一个记录在它最后需要的原始实例之前被剪断,没有答案(应该失败),一个空插曲没有动作也没有答案(应该失败). 在这549起案件中,核查员准确度为98.9%,法官为98.2%。 校验者通过每段正数,评委为97.8%;两段均拒绝每段空集,每段都接受182段差错中的6段. 法官的参考答案来自相同的记录,因此积极性对于它来说是一个容易的案例;几乎缺失的部分是信息性的部分.

blocks.en: On the 3,689 judged episodes of the ten untrained agents of Tab. 2 (the judge has no verdict for one Qwen3-VL-8B episode), the two graders agree on 93.1% of task outcomes (Cohen’s κ = 0.85 \kappa=0.85 ). The judge alone passes 201 episodes and the verifiers alone 52. Agreement ranges from 90.5% ( Qwen3.5-9B ) to 95.9% (UI-TARS-1.5-7B; Tab. 9 ).

blocks.en: The checks above use human recordings, which also supply the judge’s reference. To test both graders on agent behavior, we sample 120 of the 3,759 episodes that the ten agents produced on an earlier version of the task set (376 tasks, before the final review below), stratified by the two graders’ verdicts and oversampling their disagreements, and a labeler passes or fails each primitive from the screenshots, the action log and the request log, without seeing either grader’s verdict. A task counts as passed when every primitive passes. Weighting each stratum by its share of all episodes, the judge matches the human verdict on 92.2% of task outcomes (95% interval 84.5–98.1; κ = 0.84 \kappa=0.84 ) and the verifiers on 88.9% (81.0–94.8; κ = 0.77 \kappa=0.77 ). A second labeler labels all 120 episodes; on the 111 that neither labeler marks unsure, the two agree on 93.2% ( κ = 0.86 \kappa=0.86 ). Where only one grader passes an episode, the human sides with the judge on 34 of 36 and with the verifiers on 19 of 24 (Tab. 10 ). Per primitive, the judge matches the human on 89.6% of 245 instances and the verifiers on 87.3%; on drag & gesture the verifiers match on 98.4% of 23 and the judge on 92.3%. The audit also found eight tasks with a wrong check or a primitive the task does not need, such as a join check that passed without the meeting’s passcode; we fixed them. A final review of every task then corrected further verifiers and removed seven tasks; all other numbers in the paper use the final tasks and graders.
blocks.zh: 上面的检查使用人录,这也为法官提供了参考。 为了测试两个分级员的代理行为,我们抽查了10个分级员在较早版本的任务集(376项任务,在下文最后审查之前)上产生的3,759个分级中120个分级员通过两个分级员的判断,并过度抽取他们的分歧,一个分级员从截图、动作日志和请求日志中通过或失败了每个原始的分级员,而没有看到两个分级员的判决。 一个任务在每一个原始人经过时都算得上是过去 法官按其所有事件的比例对每个阶层进行加权,与对92.2%的任务结果(95%间隔84.5-98; =0.84\kappa=0.84)和对88.9%(81.0-94.8; =0.77\kappa=0.77)的核查人的判决一致。 第二标注者将所有120集标注;在两个标注者都没有标注不确定的111集上,两人同意93.2%(ob = 0.86\kappa= 0.86). 只有一个标注者通过一个标注时,人与法官在36集34集,核查者在24集19集(Tab. 10). 在245例中,89.6%的法官与人类匹配,87.3%的法官与核查者匹配;在拖动和手势中,核查者与23例中的98.4%匹配,法官与92.3%。 审计还发现有八项任务检查错误,或者任务不需要原始,例如没有会议密码就通过了联合检查;我们将其固定下来。 然后对每项任务进行最后审查,进一步更正核查员,删除七项任务;文件中的所有其他数字都使用最后任务和分级员。

blocks.en: This section describes the environment the sites run in, then what each actor observes and how it acts: the human annotators, the MiniWebGen executor, and the agents we train and evaluate (Tab. 11 ).
blocks.zh: 本节介绍各站点的环境,然后每个演员观察什么,以及它如何行动:人类的注释者,MiniWebGen执行者,以及我们训练和评价的代理人(第11页)。

blocks.en: All sites run on one local server and are reached through a Chromium browser with a 1280 × \times 800 viewport at device scale 1, so screenshot pixels and page coordinates coincide. Each browser session reads the shared initial state and writes its changes to its own overlay. Episodes therefore start from the same state, run in parallel without interference, and leave a per-session request log and state that verifiers inspect. Interactions that leave the page in a real browser are simulated inside the page, so that agents perform them through the UI: a file explorer opens when a file control is clicked (upload, export, save), the clipboard is enabled, and two-factor codes and confirmations arrive in the WebMail hub. Tab. 11 summarizes what each actor observes and how it acts.
blocks.zh: 所有站点运行在一个本地服务器上,通过Chrimium浏览器与设备比例尺1的1280×\times800的查看端到达,因此截图像素和页面坐标吻合. 每个浏览器会话都会读取共享的初始状态,并将其修改写入自己的覆盖. 因此,本集从同一状态开始,在不受干扰的情况下平行运行,并留下每会请求日志,并注明核查者检查. 在真实浏览器中离开页面的相互作用在页面内部模拟,这样代理通过UI来执行:在点击文件控制(上载,导出,保存)时打开一个文件探索器,启用剪贴板,两个要素代码和确认到达WebMail中枢. 附录11总结了每个行为者所观察到的情况及其行为方式。

blocks.en: Annotators record tasks in an embedded browser (Supp. D ). A script injected into every site page records each action with its target element and parameters, every HTTP request the action triggers with its response, and an observation after each change, while the server logs every request independently. Spans of primitive instances are later marked on this action timeline.
blocks.zh: 注释器在嵌入式浏览器中记录任务(Supp. D). 在每个站点页面中注入的脚本记录每个动作都有其目标元素和参数,每个HTTP请求动作触发器都有其响应,每次更改后都进行观察,而服务器独立记录每个请求. 原始实例的缩影后来被标记在这个行动时间表上.

blocks.en: The executor writes a Python script against three objects, dom , act , and expect (prompt in Supp. K ). Only act changes the page, and each of its calls is recorded together with the screenshot taken just before it. The restrictions are enforced by the sandbox rather than by the prompt. A static check rejects imports, private and dunder attribute access, while loops, class definitions, and every direct browser or JavaScript call ( e.g . , evaluate , goto , fill ). The script runs with a minimal set of builtins. act refuses hidden, off-screen, occluded, or stale targets and any target not returned by dom ; keys are allow-listed, and besides the task’s start page the script can open only the pages its step names, by typing the address as a recorded action. Click points are jittered inside the target, and drags follow a path with intermediate waypoints. Privileged DOM access thus helps the executor find targets, but every recorded step is an action on what the screenshot shows.
blocks.zh: 执行者针对三个对象写一个 Python 脚本, dom, act, and expect(primpt in Supp. K ). 只有行为会改变页面,其每次通话都会与刚刚拍摄的截图一起录制. 限制由沙盒而不是即时执行。 静态检查拒绝导入,私有和凹陷属性访问,同时循环,类定义,以及每个直接浏览器或JavaScript调用(例如,评价,去,填充). 剧本以最小的一套内建结构运行. 行为拒绝隐藏、屏蔽、隐蔽或僵化的目标以及没有被 dom 返回的目标; 密钥是允许的列表, 除了任务的起始页外, 脚本只能打开其步骤名称的页, 将地址打成记录动作 。 点击点在目标内部会颤抖,拖动会沿着中间路点的路径前进. 特权的DOM访问因此帮助执行者找到目标,但每个录制的步骤都是对截图显示的动作.

blocks.en: Every arm we train or evaluate runs in the same browser-use harness, on MiniWeb , WebArena-Lite, WebVoyager, and Online-Mind2Web alike. The state message holds the screenshot and the indexed interactive elements; the model outputs a short memory and one action (flash mode; browser-use’s own planning, judge, and message compaction are off). The task is given as “You are interacting with a web application at {start_url}. Your task: {task}”. We add three actions: drag and draw for gestures, on the 0–1000 coordinate scale that Qwen3.5 grounds in natively, and macro_done , which ends one step of a task. We remove the actions that bypass the page or need the open web: web search, LLM page extraction, in-page text and selector search, JavaScript evaluation, file-system access, saving as PDF, and direct file upload (files are chosen in the site’s file explorer). Generated trajectories are replayed in this harness to produce training rows, so each row has exactly the observation and action format the agent sees at test time. The budget is 40 site actions on MiniWeb and WebArena-Lite and 100 on the live web. In MiniWebAgent , the planner only looks, scrolls, delegates, and answers; each delegation runs the executor for at most 15 actions in the same browser.
blocks.zh: 我们训练或评估的每个手臂都运行在同一个浏览器-使用带上, 状态信息持有截图和索引互动元素;模型输出一个短的内存和一个动作(flash模式;浏览器用户自己的规划、判断和信息压缩关闭). 任务为“ 您正在与 { start_ url} 的 Web 应用程序交互 。 您的任务 : { task} ”。 我们增加了三个动作:拖动和绘制手势,在0–1000坐标尺度上,Quen3.5在原地立足,而宏-done则结束一个任务的一步. 我们删除绕过页面或需要开放网页的动作:网页搜索,LLM页面提取,页面内文本和选择器搜索,JavaScript评价,文件系统访问,保存为PDF,以及直接文件上传(文件选择在网站的文件探索器中). 生成的轨迹会在这个吊带中重播以产生训练行,因此每行都有代理商在测试时看到的精确的观察和动作格式. 预算是MiniWeb和WebArena-Lite上的40个网站行动和网上100个网站。 在MiniWebAgent 中,计划员只看,卷轴,代表,和回答;每个代表团运行执行器最多15个动作在同一浏览器中.

We start from the 595-task set that Fara-7B and MolmoWeb evaluate on [ 4 , 12 ] , which drops 48 tasks they treat as impossible. • A site that blocks our network ( − 43 -43 , 552 left). Judging follows the official evaluation script: its prompts, the last 15 screenshots, and a failure when there is no answer, with GPT-4o in place of the retired gpt-4-vision-preview .

blocks.en: No impossible-task list is published for this benchmark, so we remove only websites that gate our network. A site is set aside when at least half of its episodes, pooled over the same two full-set runs at 100 steps, end with a final answer that reports a network gate: Cloudflare, a CAPTCHA, access denied, press-and-hold, or human verification. A CAPTCHA at a login or sign-up step does not count, since a task may not need the account, and only whole sites are removed, never single episodes. Nine sites with 20 tasks meet the rule (Tab. 12 ). On the sites we keep, 5 of the 560 episodes report a gate, all on one site (apartments.com, 5 of 16). Judging uses WebJudge with o4-mini [ 34 ] .

blocks.en: Tab. 13 lists the compute and API cost of each stage, measured on our runs. The base model is served with vLLM, with the LoRA adapters loaded on the same server. MiniWeb and WebArena-Lite run on one RTX 5090 (32 GB) or one A800 (40 GB). The live-web runs use 24 GB and 40 GB GPUs with at most 24 concurrent browsers per server, since more browsers made model calls time out and episodes end early. Training all the executors in the paper took about 74 GPU-hours: 22 for the pooled executor, 30 for the family specialists, and 22 for the task-centric one. The API calls behind the reported results cost about $1.0K: $125 to generate the 3.1K trajectories that train MiniWebAgent , $170 for the VLM judge of the skill profiles (3,689 episodes), and $710 to judge the live-web runs (six WebVoyager and six Online-Mind2Web runs); this does not count collecting the task-centric trajectories.

MiniWeb和WebArena-Lite运行于一个RTX 5090(32 GB)或一个A800(40 GB)上. 直播网络运行使用24GB和40GB GPU,每个服务器最多拥有24个并行浏览器,因为更多的浏览器使模型发出超时,并提前结束事件. 论文中所有执行人员的培训耗时约74GPU小时:集合执行人员22小时,家庭专家30小时,任务中心人员22小时。 API在报告结果背后的调用成本约为1.0K:125美元用于生成培训MiniWebAgent的3.1K轨迹,170美元用于技能简介的VLM裁判(3,689集),710美元用于判断网络直播运行(6个WebVoyager和6个Online-Mind2Web运行);这不算收集以任务为中心的轨迹.

blocks.en: J.3 Why practice alone does not raise task success
blocks.zh: 第3页 单靠实践不能成功完成任务的原因

blocks.en: Trained on episodes of one or two primitives, the single agent ends whole tasks early: its median episode shrinks from 18 to 9 steps on the held-out tasks, from 40 to 8 on WebArena-Lite, from 80 to 9 on WebVoyager, and from 100 to 14 on Online-Mind2Web, while the untrained agent reaches its action budget in 56% of WebArena-Lite episodes. The trained agent’s WebVoyager run used a 40-action budget instead of 100; 17% of its episodes reached it, so its WebVoyager number may be slightly low, but its median episode (9 steps) is far below either budget.
blocks.zh: 接受过一两个原始人剧集的训练,单人代理提前结束整个任务:其中位剧集在被搁置任务上从18步缩减到9步,在WebArena-Lite上从40步缩短到8步,在WebVoyager上从80步缩短到9步,在Online-Mind2Web上从100步缩短到14步,而未经训练的代理则在WebArena-Lite的56%的剧集中达到行动预算. 训练有素的代理商WebVoyager的运行使用了40动作预算而不是100动作预算;其17%的剧集到达了它,因此其WebVoyager的节目数量可能略低,但其中位插曲(9步)远低于两个预算.

blocks.en: J.4 Stop-early control
blocks.zh: J.4 停止早期控制

blocks.en: Trained on the same steps without each episode’s final done step, the single agent no longer stops early: its median episode runs the whole 40-action budget on the held-out tasks and on WebArena-Lite, which it reaches in 96% of episodes on both. Its task success does not rise: 34.4% on the held-out tasks against 39.2% with the done steps ( p = 0.42 p=0.42 ) and 22.5% on WebArena-Lite against 20.3% ( p = 0.44 p=0.44 ), far below MiniWebAgent (58.1% and 36.4%; p < 10 − 3 p<10^{-3} for both). Removing the early stop alone does not chain primitives into tasks. Without trained done steps it answers worse: on the 21 held-out tasks that end in an answer it passes 23.8% against 34.9% with them. On the 41 tasks that need no answer, which the missing steps cannot cost it, it passes 39.8% against 41.5% ( p = 0.91 p=0.91 ) and 61.0% for MiniWebAgent ( p = 0.007 p=0.007 ).
blocks.zh: 在没有每集最后完成的一步的情况下,对同样的步骤进行训练,单一的代理不再提前停止:其中位插曲运行着整个40个动作预算用于被搁置的任务和WebArena-Lite,在这两集的96%中都达到了这一预算。 它的任务成功率没有上升:被搁置的任务占34.4%,已完成步骤的占39.2%(p=0.42 p=0.42),WebArena-Lite的占22.5%(p=0.44 p=0.44),远远低于MiniWebAgent(58.1%和36.4%;p < 10 - 3 p < 10 > 3}两者)。 仅删除早期站点不会将原始人连锁成任务. 如果没有经过培训的步骤,则答案就更糟糕:在21项被搁置的任务中,答案是23.8%,与之相比34.9%。 在41项不需要回答的任务上,缺失步骤无法花费,它比41.5%(p=0.91 p=0.91)和MiniWebAgent(p=0.007 p=0.007)分别超过39.8%和61.0%.

blocks.en: J.5 WebArena-Lite by site
blocks.zh: J.5 按网站分列的WebArena-Lite

blocks.en: Two training sites reuse WebArena’s Reddit and GitLab data (Tab. 8 ). Tab. 16 splits WebArena-Lite by site. Without the Reddit and GitLab tasks, MiniWebAgent still gains 8.9 points over the untrained single agent ( p = 0.001 p=0.001 ) and 4.8 over the untrained planner ( p = 0.10 p=0.10 ). Over the single agent the largest gain is on Reddit; over the untrained planner, the trained executor gains most on GitLab and loses on Reddit.

blocks.en: J.6 Model calls
blocks.zh: J.6 模式调用

blocks.en: J.7 Robustness of the skill profiles
blocks.zh: J.7 技能简介的健全性

blocks.en: Counting only the primitive instances whose earlier primitives in the task all passed, so that a family is not penalized for failures upstream of it, drag & gesture remains the weakest family for each of the ten agents. Averaged over the agents, success by chain length stays within 3.8 points of the independent-primitive prediction p n p^{n} at every length (Fig. 6 , left). Among the six agents with their own loops, five have a drag action in their released action spaces ( Fara1.5-4B : left_click_drag ; MolmoWeb: drag_and_drop ; UI-TARS-1.5-7B: drag ; OpenCUA-7B: dragTo ) and still pass at most 17% of drag instances; Fara-7B’s has none, so its 0% is by construction. Graded by the task verifiers instead of the judge, drag & gesture is the weakest family of every one of the ten agents; pooled over the agents, the verifiers pass 11.2% of drag instances against 34.8% for the next-weakest family.
blocks.zh: 仅仅计算在任务中早期原始人全部经过的原始例子,这样一个家庭就不会因为上游的失败而受到惩罚,拖动和手势仍然是十名特工中每一个最弱的家庭. 按链长计算,平均成功率保持在独立原始预测的3.8点以内pn=pn=(图6,左)。 在拥有自身循环的6个代理中,5个在其释放的动作空格中有拖动动作(Fara1.5-4B:left_click_drag;MolmoWeb:拖动_and_drop;UI-TARS-1.5-7B:拖动;OpenCUA-7B:拖动To),并且仍然通过最多17%的拖动例;Fara-7B's没有拖动动作,因此它的0%通过构建. 根据任务核查员而不是法官的等级,拖动和手势是十名代理人中每一名代理人中最弱的家族;在代理人之上集合,核查员通过11.2%的拖动,而次弱家族则通过34.8%的拖动。

blocks.en: J.8 Training and data details
blocks.zh: J.8 培训和数据细节

blocks.en: Of the drag & gesture trajectories in the training set, 100 draw signatures, 23 reposition items, and 28 pan a map, all with real drags; 73 of the 74 slider trajectories set the value by clicking on the track, which the sliders accept, and the playback and ranking trajectories use clicks.
blocks.zh: 在训练集的拖动和手势轨迹中,有100个绘图签名,23个重新定位项目,以及28个泛图,都带有真正的拖动;74个滑动轨迹中,有73个通过点击滑动者接受的轨迹设定了值,播放和排名轨迹使用点击.

blocks.en: The executor is a rank-64 LoRA ( α = 128 \alpha=128 , dropout 0.05) on the language model’s attention and MLP projections, trained for one epoch on the 27,646 steps of 𝒟 \mathcal{D} (3,128 plain trajectories, 857 two-trajectory chains, and 629 trajectories with an injected and corrected mistake), at learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} with a cosine schedule and a batch of 8 steps. The task-centric executor uses the same recipe on 27,644 steps from 3,795 trajectories, collected on the 52 training sites with our reimplementation of InSTA’s pipeline [ 27 ] . Gemini 3.5 Flash proposed 140 goal-level tasks per site from its home page; the untrained Qwen3.5-4B attempted each in our harness, writing every step’s memory and action; Gemini 3.5 Flash judged each episode from its screenshots, actions, the server’s request log and its data changes. In our skill data, the actions come from MiniWebGen ’s verified executions and Qwen3.5-4B writes each step’s memory when they are replayed, so both sets carry the same model’s text. The judge accepted 4,308 of the 7,267 episodes, and trajectories were drawn from those round-robin over the sites up to the step budget. On the 310 human tasks of the training sites, run by the same agent, this judge agrees with the task verifiers on 87.1% of episodes, with 77.5% precision and 92.2% recall; our generated trajectories instead pass a backend check by construction.
blocks.zh: 执行者在语言模型的注意和MLP预测中为64级LORA(α = 128\alpha = 128,辍学 = 0.05),在D\mathcal{D}的27 646步(3 128平方轨距、857双轨距链和629步有注射和修正错误的轨距)上接受一个世纪的培训,学习速度为10 - 4 10 - Q-4),有余弦表和一组8步。 以任务为中心的执行者在52个训练站点收集的3 795个轨迹的27 644个步骤上采用了相同的配方,我们重新安装了InSTA的管道[27]。 双子座3.5 Flash从其主页上提出了140个目标级任务;未经过训练的Quen3.5-4B在我们的操纵下尝试了每一个步骤,写下了每个步骤的记忆和行动;双子座3.5 Flash从其截图、动作、服务器的请求日志和数据变化中判断了每一集。 在我们的技巧数据中,动作来自MiniWebGen经核实的处决,Quen3.5-4B在重播时会写下每一步的记忆,所以两套都背着同一个模型的文字. 法官接受了7 267集中的4 308集,并且从这些场地的圆形轮盘中抽取了直至台阶预算的轨迹。 关于由同一代理人管理的培训地点的310个人类任务,这位法官同意87.1%的事件的任务核查员,精确度为77.5%,召回率为92.2%;我们产生的轨迹则通过施工后端检查。

blocks.en: Over the generation runs that produced the training pool, 6,384 candidate tasks were proposed, 5,432 passed a dry run on the site’s state, 4,467 were worded into instructions, and 4,011 were executed with the backend showing the intended change, in 5,785 attempts (3,653 first-attempt successes). After removing near-duplicates and capping trajectories per site, 3,428 were kept; 3,128 of them form the training pool (the rest were retired in review or did not replay in the agent harness). Failed attempts were mostly a scripted action the page did not accept, such as a hidden, covered or stale element (903), and a failed scripted check on the page (528); the backend check rejected 185.
blocks.zh: 在培训人才库的一代人中,提出了6 384项候选任务,5 432项在场地状态上通过了模拟,4 467项被写入指令,4 011项在5 785次尝试(3 653次首次尝试成功)中执行后端显示预期变化。 在移除每个场地的近重复和封顶轨迹后,保留了3,428个;其中3,128个组成了训练池(其余的被审查后退役,或者没有在代理吊带中重新播放). 尝试失败大多是页面不接受的脚本动作,如隐藏,覆盖或 stale 元素(903),以及页面上的脚本检查失败(528);后端检查拒绝了185.

blocks.en: The 13 held-out sites were fixed once, before any trajectory was generated. Three of the 62 held-out tasks also use a training site (email, team chat, or the code editor) for a cross-site step.

blocks.en: K.1 Macro induction
blocks.zh: K.1 宏观入门

blocks.en: The orchestrator prompt of the macro mining pipeline (Supp. A ), given to Claude Opus 4.8. It runs the first pass, the deduplication with a human annotator, and the second, order-free pass over the tasks of WebArena, Mind2Web, WebShop, and WebVoyager.
blocks.zh: 向克劳德·奥普斯4.8提供的大型采矿管道(Supp.A.)的指挥器。 它运行着第一个传球,与人类的解码员进行调试,第二个无序传球,通过WebArena,Mind2Web,WebShop和WebVoyager的任务.

blocks.en: System Context: You are an autonomous orchestrator managing a multi-stage data extraction pipeline. You are connected to a local SQLite database (macros.db). The schema is pre-defined with strict relational constraints: the verbs and modifiers registries only accept status IN (’seed’, ’established’, ’proposed’). Goal: Read the task datasets (WebArena, Mind2Web, WebShop, WebVoyager), extract a unified macro action space without letting processing order bias the result, execute database updates directly, facilitate a human-in-the-loop deduplication phase, and finally plot an order-free discovery curve. Two invariants that govern the whole pipeline (do not violate): 1. Independence during proposal. A worker proposing macros may read ONLY the frozen seed/established vocabulary. It must NEVER read another worker’s proposed entries. All proposals from all workers and datasets meet for the first time in Phase 2. 2. Order-freeness of all reported numbers. No coverage claim or curve may depend on the order in which tasks or datasets were processed. Anything order-sensitive is averaged over many random orderings. Execution Strategy: Split this workload and delegate to sub-agents or separate context sessions as needed. Do not process all tasks in a single continuous loop. Track your state and process in batches. Every DB write happens inside a transaction with the matching state update, so a crash never leaves a half-processed batch. Execute the following phases sequentially. ------------------------------------------------------------ Phase 0: Read and Understand Read and understand the following, by priority: - docs/macros_def.md  (authoritative). This is the frozen, reviewed definition; the whole pipeline inherits its axis decision (intent, not mechanics), its closed verb set, and its closed modifier vocabulary. - docs/MiniWeb_brainstorm.pdf (loosely, for project intent only; the macro definition in macros_def.md overrides anything here). Confirm that macros.db is seeded BEFORE Phase 1: the seed verbs and modifiers must come from the taxonomy backbone and blind brainstorm in macros_def.md, so the vocabulary’s origin is NOT any dataset. Do not start Phase 1 against an empty registry. ------------------------------------------------------------ Phase 1: The Proposer (Independent Task Analysis and Extraction) Delegate to one or more workers, in batches (e.g., 20 tasks per batch). Track which task IDs are processed. Objective: Iterate through unprocessed tasks in webarena_tasks, mind2web_tasks, webshop_tasks, and webvoyager_tasks, and emit, per task, the macros involved -- proposing new vocabulary only when the frozen vocab genuinely cannot express the intent. Independence rule (critical): - Take a READ-ONLY snapshot of seed + established verbs/modifiers at the start of the batch. Match against THIS snapshot only. - Workers must NOT query or reuse each other’s proposed entries. Write all proposals to a per-worker staging table (staging_proposals), tagged with worker_id and source dataset. Nothing proposed is visible to any other worker. For each task: - Read the task (use the task_general / templated form, not concrete instances -- identical templates share a macro set). - Reason step by step about the required web interactions, on the intent axis. Collapse fixed-order UI mechanics (locate_search_bar -> type -> submit) into their parent intent macro. Do not emit mechanics as macros (see macros_def.md, "What is NOT a macro"). - Matching logic: * If a required macro maps semantically to a seed/established (verb, modifier) tuple in the snapshot, USE those IDs. * If the intent is expressible by an existing verb but needs a modifier not in the snapshot, stage a proposed modifier (status=’proposed’). * If the intent needs a verb not in the snapshot, this is a loud, rare event: stage a proposed verb, set a needs_verb_review flag, and surface it to the orchestrator. Verb proposals are human-gated in Phase 2 and should be the exception -- the verb set is meant to saturate small. A flood of verb proposals means the seed was too thin (see Phase 1.5). - Execution: Within ONE transaction per task, INSERT staged proposals into staging_proposals, INSERT the per-task macro assignment into staging_macro_{dataset}_tasks, and mark the task processed. Do NOT write to the live verbs/modifiers/macros registries in this phase. Continue batching until all tasks are processed. Phase 1.5: Seed-adequacy gate Before merging, count accepted-shaped proposals. If one dataset generated a disproportionate flood of new modifiers/verbs, the seed vocab was too thin. Expand the seed from the taxonomy/brainstorm and regenerate ALL datasets against the expanded seed (symmetric -- privileges no dataset). Only proceed to Phase 2 once proposal volume is sane. ------------------------------------------------------------ Phase 2: Deduplicator (Provenance-Blind, Human-in-the-Loop Merge) Act as an interactive terminal assistant for this phase. Do not automate the final decisions. This is the ONLY place proposals from different workers/datasets meet. Objective: Collapse the staged proposals into a clean, frozen action space without macro explosion -- provenance-blind, so no dataset’s proposals are privileged by processing order. - Pool and strip provenance: Load ALL staging_proposals from ALL workers and datasets into one set. Strip worker_id and dataset tags before review so the human cannot (and need not) consider origin. Overlap/origin is never an input to the merge. - Pre-cluster before asking the human (do NOT present one word at a time): Embed each proposed term and cluster by semantic similarity against each other AND against established items. Present the human with groups, not isolated words -- e.g., "6 proposals resemble search: [list]. Suggest: merge all into search / split into N / keep K as new." - Interaction loop (per cluster): * Print the cluster, your semantic analysis, and a suggested action. * Prompt: (M)erge all into [suggestion], (S)plit (specify groups), (A)ccept listed as new, or (D)rop? * Pause and wait for human terminal input. * needs_verb_review clusters are always shown explicitly and never auto-suggested as merges. - Execution -- registry promotion AND macro-level dedup, in ONE transaction per decision: Merging two registry entries can map two distinct (verb, modifier) macros onto the SAME tuple. This is a macro-level dedup, NOT a simple ID swap. For each merge, in a single transaction: 1. Repoint references: UPDATE staging_macro_* (and macros) rows from the dropped ID to the kept ID. 2. Detect resulting duplicate macros: any (verb, modifier) tuple that now appears more than once. 3. Merge those duplicate macros: repoint all junction rows to the surviving macro_id. 4. Only now DELETE the orphaned registry entry. Verify no FK/uniqueness violation before COMMIT; ROLLBACK on conflict and re-present to the human. * (A): UPDATE status proposed -> established. * (D): drop the proposal and its staged assignments. - Output: a fully established registry and a finalized macro table. Snapshot this as an immutable artifact (frozen_vocab.json) -- Phase 3 reads the snapshot, never the live DB. ------------------------------------------------------------ Phase 3: The Auditor (Symmetric Relabeling and Coverage Audit) Delegate to a pool of analytical workers capable of parallel execution. Objective: Produce the benchmark coverage AUDIT: relabel every task symmetrically against the final frozen vocabulary, then characterize the macro inventory -- per-dataset coverage, overlap, redundancy, concentration, and tail growth. This phase DESCRIBES the inventory; it does not test a hypothesis. Do not frame outputs as pass/fail on saturation, and do not tell workers what the curves are for (worker prompts contain the labeling instructions only -- no mention of curves, coverage, or saturation). - Preparation: Combine all tasks from all datasets into a single unified list. - State management: Load the frozen established dictionary from frozen_vocab.json as an immutable in-memory snapshot passed to every worker. Workers do not read the live DB (no Phase-2 edit can race a Phase-3 read). - Symmetric relabeling (this is the point of the phase): Phase-1 assignments were made against per-worker snapshots that predate the merge; they are NOT comparable across datasets. Remove them. Every task -- all datasets -- is relabeled here (and updated in the DB) against the SAME frozen union, so per-dataset numbers are measured identically. * For each task, the worker assigns the macro sequence using ONLY the frozen dictionary. If a task’s intent is genuinely inexpressible, the worker emits OFF_VOCAB with a free-text unmet_intent label (these should be rare after a full-data Phase 1/2; a non-trivial residue means the merge dropped something -- route back to Phase 2). * Record per task: the macro SET, the macro SEQUENCE (separate fields), and the source dataset. Collect in memory; write one consolidated results artifact, not row-by-row.
blocks.zh: 系统背景 : 你是管理多阶段数据提取管道的自主管弦乐手 您已连接到本地的 SQLite 数据库( macros. db) 。 预设办法有严格的关系限制:动词和修改语登记处只接受IN(种子、既定、拟议)的地位。 目标: 读取任务数据集(WebArena,Mind2Web,WebShop,WebVoyager),提取一个统一的宏动作空间,而不会让处理命令偏向结果,直接执行数据库更新,方便一个人-在-在-在-在-脱落阶段,最后绘制一个无订单的发现曲线. 管理整个输油管的两种变化因素(不违反): 1. 提案期间的独立性。 提出宏的工人只能读冷冻种子/既定词汇。 它永远不能阅读另一个工人的建议条目。 所有工人和数据集的所有提议都首次在第二阶段开会。 2. 所有报告数字的无序性。 任何覆盖范围要求或曲线都不得取决于任务或数据集的处理顺序。 任何对命令敏感的东西都会被许多随机命令所平均. 执行战略:将工作量分成两部分,并视需要委托给子代理人或单独的上下文会议。 不在一个连续循环中处理所有任务 。 分批跟踪您的状态和进程 。 每个 DB 写入都发生在匹配状态更新的交易内部,所以崩溃永远不会留下一个半处理的批次. 依次执行以下阶段. —————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— 第0阶段:按优先顺序阅读和理解以下内容: -docs/macros_def.md(权威)。 这是被冻结的,经过审查的定义;整个管道继承其轴决定(intent,而非力学),其闭合动词集,以及其闭合的修饰词汇. - docs/MiniWeb_brainstorm.pdf(略为,仅用于项目意图;宏中的宏定义_def.md在这里压倒任何东西). 确认宏.db在第一阶段之前就已经播种了:种子动词和修饰词必须来自分类主干线和宏s_def.md中的盲脑暴,因此词汇的起源不是任何数据集。 不对空登记册启动第一阶段 。 —————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— 第一阶段:分批(如每批20项任务)向一名或多名工人提名(独立任务分析和提取)代表。 跟踪处理哪个任务ID 。 目标:在 webarena_tasks, mind2web_tasks, webshop_tasks, 和webvoyager_tasks中通过未处理的任务进行排列, 并发布每个任务, 所涉的宏 -- 只有当冻 Vocab 真正无法表达意图时, 才会提出新的词汇 。 独立规则(关键): - 在批次开始时,对种子+既定动词/修饰语进行READ-ONLY快照. 只匹配此快照 。 - 工人不得查询或重新使用对方的拟议条目。 将所有提案写到每个工人的中程表(stage_ propositions),并加贴工人身份和源数据集的标签。 任何其他工人都看不到任何建议。 对每项任务: - 读取任务( 使用任务_ 通用/ 模板格式, 而非具体实例 -- 相同的模板共享宏集) 。 - 在意图轴上逐步说明所需网络互动的理由。 将固定顺序的UI力学(locate_search_bar - > type - >提交)折叠成其母意图宏. 不要将力学作为宏(见macros_def.md,"What is not a macro")排放. - 匹配逻辑: * 如果需要宏映射到快照中的种子/已建立(动词,修饰符)的图,则使用这些ID。 * 如果用现有动词来表示意图,但需要一个不放在快照中的修饰者,则设置一个拟议修饰者(地位建议)。 如果意图需要一个不出现在快照中的动词,这是一个响亮的,罕见的事件: 设置一个拟议动词,设置一个需要_动词_预告旗,并将其表面显示给管弦乐手. 动词提案在第二阶段是人为的,应该是例外——动词集意在饱和小. 动词提案泛滥意味着种子太薄(见1.5阶段). - 执行:在每项任务的一项交易中,INSERT将建议分为:中建_建议;INSERT将每个任务的宏观任务分为中建_macro_{dataset}_任务,并标注所处理的任务。 在此阶段不要写入活动词/修改词/macros 注册。 继续批量,直到所有任务处理完毕。 1.5阶段:种子-充分门合并前,计为已接受的形制建议书. 如果一个数据集产生不相称的洪水新修饰剂/动词,种子花序太细. 扩展分类学/脑风暴中的种子,并将所有数据集与扩大的种子(对称 -- -- 特权无数据集)重新生成。 只有在提案量正常后,才进入第二阶段。 —————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— 第2阶段:配电器(Provenance-Blind,Human-in-the-Loop合并) 担任此阶段的互动终端助理. 不要使最后决定自动化。 这是不同工人/数据集提案的唯一地点。 目标:将已上演的提案折叠成一个干净的,没有宏观爆炸的冻结的动作空间 -- -- 出处盲,所以没有数据集的提案通过处理命令获得特权. - 游泳池和脱衣舞出处: 从所有工人和数据集中装入所有中继器和数据集。 脱衣舞女工的身份证和数据集标签在审查之前, 重叠/ 来源绝不是合并的输入 。 - 在问人类之前预先分组(一次不提出一个词): 按语义上的相似性将每个拟议术语和组别嵌入彼此和既定项目。 向人类展示团体,而不是孤立的单词——例如,"6个提议类似搜索:[列表]. 建议:将全部合并到搜索中 / 拆分为 N / 保持 K 成为新的". - 交互循环(每组): * 打印集群、你的语义分析以及建议的行动。 * 提示:(M) 全部输入[建议],(S)plit(具体说明组),(A) 被列作新的或(D)rop? 暂停等待人类终端输入. *需要_动词_审查组总是明确显示,从不自动推荐为合并. - 执行 -- -- 登记促进和宏观层面解密,每项决定一次交易: 合并两个注册条目可以将两个不同的(动词,修饰语)宏映射到SAME Tuple上. 这是一个宏层面的调试,不是简单的ID交换. 对于每次合并,在一次交易中: 1. 重点引用: UpDATE cluding_macro_*(和宏)行从投放的ID到保存的ID. 2. 检测所产生的重复宏:现在不止一次出现的任何(动词、修饰词)。 3. 合并这些重复的宏:将所有交叉行重新对准幸存的宏_id。 4. 只有在现在才将孤儿登记入册。 在Committee之前核实没有违反FK/独特性的情况; ROLLBACK 有关冲突并重新提交给人类。 *(A):提议的最新地位 - > 已建立。 *(D):放弃提议及其已完成的任务。 - 产出:建立完整的登记册和最后确定的宏观表格。 截图是不可改变的文物(frozen_vocab.json)—— 第三阶段读了快照,从不直播DB. —————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————— 第3阶段:审计员(对称重贴标签和覆盖审计)向能够平行执行的一组分析工作者派出代表。 目标:制作基准覆盖面 AUIDT:将每个任务与最终冻结的词汇对称重新标注,然后描述宏观清单 -- -- 每个数据集的覆盖面、重叠、冗余、集中和尾部增长。 这一阶段DESCRIBES 库存;它不测试一个假设。 不要在饱和度上将输出设定为通过/失败,不要告诉工人曲线的用途(工人提示只包含标签说明 -- -- 不提及曲线、覆盖或饱和度)。 - 准备:将所有数据集的所有任务合并为单一的统一清单。 - 国家管理: 将冻结的字典从froster_vocab.json装上,作为不可改变的记忆快照传递给每个工人. 工人不读现场DB(没有Phase-2编辑可以比赛Phase-3读). - 对称重贴标签(这是相位点): 第一阶段的任务是根据合并之前的每个工人的快照完成的;这些快照在数据集之间并不具有可比性。 拿掉他们。 每一个任务——所有数据集——都在这里重新贴上标签(并在DB中更新),以对抗SAME冷冻联盟,因此每个数据集的编号都得到相同的测量. * 《大会正式记录,第五十八届会议,补编第5号》(A/C.6/61/Rev.1)。 对于每项任务,工人只使用冻结字典来分配宏序列。 如果任务的意图是真实的无法表达的,工人会用自由文本未实现的_VOCAB标签(在完整数据第1/2阶段之后,这些标签应该少见;非三角残留意味着合并会掉落一些东西 -- -- 途径回到第2阶段). *每个任务记录:宏SET,宏SEQUENCE(分离字段),和源数据集. 在记忆中收集;写一个综合结果文物,而不是逐行收集.

blocks.en: K.2 MiniWebGen : guide summarization
blocks.zh: K.2 MiniWebGen: 指南综述

blocks.en: Before any task is generated, MiniWebGen writes one site-agnostic guide per primitive ( datagen/guides.py , write_guide ). The model is gemini-3.5-flash ( DATAGEN_MODEL_GUIDE ), called in JSON mode at temperature 0.2 with this system prompt:
blocks.zh: 在生成任何任务之前, MiniWebGen 每原始写一个站点不可知指南(datagen/guides.py, write_guide ). 该型号为Gemini-3.5-flash(DATAGEN_MODEL_GUIDE),使用JSON模式,温度为0.2,此系统即时:

blocks.en: You distill human demonstrations of ONE web-UI macro into a short, site-agnostic procedure for someone who will drive a browser with mouse and keyboard only. Generalize across sites; never name a specific site, product, value or CSS selector. Reply ONLY JSON.
blocks.zh: 您将 ONE 网络- UI 宏的人类演示 提炼成一个简短的、 站点不可知的程序, 供只使用鼠标和键盘驱动浏览器的人使用 。 跨站点通用;从不命名特定站点,产品,值或CSS选择器. 仅回复杰森。

blocks.en: The user message is one JSON object. {macro} is the primitive’s canonical name. {description} , {example} , {span_start} and {span_end} are its fields in the registry, data/macros.yaml , and {rubric} is its judge rubric from the same file (an example is shown with the macro judge below). The demonstrations are the human spans of the primitive recorded on training sites, at most 24, in the format of the next box. The end-state screenshots of the first three demonstrations, when recorded, are attached as images before the text.
blocks.zh: 用户消息是一个 JSON 对象 。 {macro}是原始的犬科名称。 {描述},{例},{span_start}和{span_end}是它位于注册簿中的字段,数据/macros.yaml,和{rubric}是它来自同一文件的评委(下面的宏评委举了一个例子)。 演示是训练场上原始记录的人类跨度,最多24个,形式是下一个盒子. 前三次示威的结束状态截图,经记录后作为图像附在文字之前.

Screenshots attached show end states of a few demonstrations.", "output_schema": { "summary": "one sentence: what the macro achieves", "preconditions": ["what must be true / on screen before starting"], "steps": ["ordered, concrete physical steps (look for X, click Y, ...)"], "variants": [{"when": "a UI variation seen in the demos", "do": "how to handle it"}], "watch_for": ["visual cues that the step worked or went wrong"], "completion_signal": "how to tell the macro is done (page/URL/listing change)", "pitfalls": ["common mistakes"] } }

blocks.en: When the primitive has no human demonstration on a training site, demonstrations is empty, no image is attached, and note reads instead: “No human demonstration is available: write the procedure from the description, example and rubric, for the common ways web apps present this interaction.”
blocks.zh: 当原始人在一个训练场地上没有人类示威时,示威是空的,没有附图,注则转而写道: “没有人类演示:从描述、示例和标题中写出网络应用程序呈现这种互动的共同方式的程序。 “

blocks.en: Each demonstration is the annotated span of one human recording. It holds the task instruction, the annotator’s subtask for this primitive, up to two actions recorded just before the span ( context_before ), and the span’s actions. Each action is one line: the recorded event, its target cut to 90 characters, and its value cut to 50 characters when there is one. The block below is one of the nine demonstrations behind the filter_by_slider guide, a recording on the e-commerce site, rebuilt from the current annotation files with the code’s formatting. Its context_before is empty because the span starts at the recording’s first action.
blocks.zh: 每一次演示都是人类记录的附加说明。 它持有任务指示,即这个原始事物的注释员的子任务,最多在跨度之前记录了两个动作(上下文),以及跨度的动作. 每个动作都是一行:记录的事件,其目标切成90个字符,在有字符时其值切成50个字符. 下面的块是过滤器_by_sliver指南背后的9个演示之一,这是在电子商务站点上录制的,从目前的注释文件中重建而成的代码格式. 它的前身是空的,因为跨度始于录制的第一个动作。

blocks.en: The model’s JSON reply is stored per primitive and rendered to Markdown ( render_md ). The executor receives the JSON form of the same guide, without its provenance. As an example output, the guide for filter_by_slider ( data/datagen/guides/filter_by_slider.md ) is:
blocks.zh: 该模型的JSON回复按原始存储,并提供给Markdown(commer_md). 执行人收到同名指南的JSON形式,没有来源. 作为示例输出,过滤器_by_sliver(数据/datagen/guides/filter_by_sliver.md)的指南是:

blocks.en: # Guide: filter_by_slider Narrow down search or listing results by adjusting a range slider to a specific value and applying the filter. ## Preconditions - The browser is on a page displaying a list of items (e.g., products, events, jobs). - A filter panel or section containing a range slider (such as price, rating, or salary) is visible. ## Steps 1. Locate the target range slider control on the page. 2. Click and drag the slider handle (or click at points along the slider track) until the associated numerical label displays the desired target value. 3. Click the ’Apply’, ’Filter’, or equivalent submission button to update the results. ## Watch for - The text label near the slider updating in real-time to reflect the current value as you drag. - A loading spinner or temporary overlay indicating the results are updating. ## Pitfalls - Dragging too quickly and releasing on the wrong value; use fine mouse movements or keyboard arrow keys if supported to dial in the exact number. - Forgetting to click the ’Apply’ button after adjusting the slider, leaving the unfiltered results on screen. ## Variants - **The slider is linked to a text input box** -- Type the target value directly into the input box instead of dragging the slider. - **There is no ’Apply’ button** -- Release the slider handle to let the page automatically refresh and apply the filter. ## Done when The list of results updates to reflect the filtered range, or the page URL changes to include the new filter parameters. _Distilled by gemini-3.5-flash on 2026-09-27 from 9 human demonstrations on train sites only._
blocks.zh: # 指南: 过滤器_ by_ 滑块 通过调整范围滑动器到特定值并应用过滤器来缩小搜索或列出结果。 # 先决条件 - 浏览器在页面上显示项目列表(如产品,事件,工作). - 显示含有范围滑动器(如价格、评级或薪金)的过滤面板或部分。 □步骤 1. 在页面上定位目标范围滑动控制。 2. 点击并拖动滑动手柄(或沿着滑动轨迹的点点击),直到相关数字标签显示所希望的目标值. 3. 点击 " Apply " 、 " Filter " 或类似的提交按钮以更新结果。 # 看着 - 在滑动器附近实时更新以反映当前拖动值的文本标签。 - 显示结果的加载旋转器或临时覆盖正在更新。 □ □ □ □ 陷阱 - 拖曳过快, 在错误的值上释放; 如果支持拨打准确的数字, 使用精细的鼠标移动或键盘箭头键 。 - 忘记在调整滑动器后点击 'Apply ' 按钮,将未过滤的结果留在屏幕上。 □ 变体 - ** 滑动器与文本输入框链接** - —— - 说 直接输入目标值, 而不是拖动滑动器。 - ** 没有 'Apply ' 按钮** - —— - 说 释放滑动手柄让页面自动刷新并应用过滤器. □ □ □ □ 完成时间 反映过滤范围的结果更新列表,或页面 URL 更改以包含新的过滤参数. 2026-09-27年火车站上9次人类示威,

blocks.en: K.3 MiniWebGen : instruction suggestion
blocks.zh: K.3 小型网络Gen:指示建议

blocks.en: Stage 3 of MiniWebGen ( datagen/suggester.py , suggest ) phrases a sampled task as a natural instruction. The sampler has already fixed every parameter (site, control, option, start state); the model, gemini-3.5-flash in JSON mode at temperature 0.9, only writes the wording. System prompt:
blocks.zh: MiniWebGen第3阶段(datagen/suggester.py,建议)将一个抽样任务作为自然指令. 采样器已经固定了每个参数(站点,控制,选项,起始状态);模型,Gemini-3.5-flash在JSON模式中温度0.9,只写措辞. 系统提示 :

blocks.en: You write realistic instructions a person would give a web assistant. You are given the exact parameters of the task (which control, which option); do not change, add or drop any. Mention every option by its visible text (you may drop punctuation/casing, not words). Never mention HTML, CSS, URL parameters, field names in snake_case, or the word ’dropdown’ unless natural. Reply ONLY JSON.
blocks.zh: 你写现实的指示 一个人会给一个网络助理。 您可以得到任务的确切参数( 哪个控件, 哪个选项); 不更改、 添加或删除任何选项 。 以可见的文本提及每个选项(您可以放下标点/标点,而不是单词) 。 永远不要提及 HTML, CSS, URL 参数, 字段名称 in snake_ case, 或 " drot down " 一词, 除非是自然的 。 仅回复杰森。

blocks.en: The user message is one JSON object. {site_name} is the site’s display name and {page_title} the title of the page that holds the control. Each step gives the primitive, a description of the control written by its control kind ( {control_description} ; for a range slider, an object with the type “a range slider filtering the listing”, the control’s label, its range and an empty list of choices), and the sampled option in words ( {option} ).
